page.notes: Left margin, first note: "Litera de / iureDam- / monēsium, / vulgòdiēt" was read as one line; the last word is uncertain and marked [?]. Second note is in black letter ("de Büer / bzieff bā / den Dā."); its letters are doubtful, notably "Büer" and "Dā", and the transcription is a best reading. Placement of both notes within the paragraph follows their height beside the text lines. The date "xxii" and the spelling "Vpstallefbomum" are copied as printed; the date numeral may be read as xxii. The text is one paragraph with no indent at the start, continuing from the previous page, and the last line "suc-cessores" is the printed continuation of the word. No catchword or signature is printed.
